blocks.text: Stronger, More Stable Wi-Fi, Where You Need ItUpgrade your home network with the TP-Link Wi-Fi Range Extender RE315. The AC1200 extender connects to your existing router and expands its Wi-Fi signal into areas your router can’t reach on its own. It offers coverage up to 1600 sq. ft., making it ideal for apartments, condos, or small homes. Enjoy a stable network experience wherever you need it at home. Great for parents, professionals, or anyone who needs their signal extended. This range extender is EasyMesh-compatible, meaning you can expand your network for seamless, whole-home coverage by connecting the RE315 to any EasyMesh-compatible router or mesh WiFi system under a single WiFi name. The 100 Mbps Ethernet port delivers wired connections to smart TVs, streaming devices, and desktops.This WiFi booster has dimensions of 3.5 x 1.4 x 4.9 inches. The RE315 is compatible with all WiFi-enabled devices and routers or access points. It supports features such as Wireless Statistics and the ability to enable or disable the wireless radio. The user-friendly Tether app includes Cloud Management, LED Control, and Access Control.The package / purchase includes an AC1200 Wi-Fi Range Extender RE315 and a quick installation guide. It operates in temperatures ranging from 32℉ to 104℉ and humidity levels of 10%-90% (non-condensing). It has regulatory certifications from CE and RoHS.
